_level_scale: Tier C (#473, #449 first draft): pasted from level_scale_draft.gd --step=16 --stage=temple_of_time, not tuned. exp_level(t) is Sleepywood's effective level E_sw at each keyframe time, and level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (16 - 5), so every region levels the character at Sleepywood's pace and this step is thirty-three effective levels harder. The draft raised no warning (the highest level, 89.85, is below the 131 where the reference curves go flat). The pool mobs are Lv101, Lv116 and Lv131, so their canonical EXP is measured against the level curve at their own levels (ratios 1.01, 0.94 and 1.00; level_curve.json holds its Lv131 values above 131). Without the scale the stage would run its canonical monsters at full strength from 0:00 for a Lv1 character. C13 (#475, tier C, calibrated on training seeds 1-4): level(t) = lerp(1, E_sw(t) + 6.25, min(1, t/600)): the stage starts at effective level 1 and reaches this step's level at 10:00, because a Lv1 character cannot take Lv16-and-up damage from the first second; 6.25 levels above Sleepywood here (0.75 per step to step 12, 0.25 per step after it: the first draft's +3 per step out-ran what a band's equipment adds).
